headline: Norway’s Equinor agrees to invest 42bn US dollars in Lindi LNG project
summary: Tanzania is set to attract an estimated $42bn investment from Norway's Equinor for the Liquefied Natural Gas project in Lindi Region. The proposal was discussed in talks between Tanzanian and Norwegian officials.
why: Equinor is a Norway-based integrated energy company with large offshore oil and gas operations. LNG export projects like this are long-term capital commitments that affect global gas supply.

impacts.name: Equinor
impacts.why: Equinor would commit a $42bn investment to develop the Lindi LNG project.
